title: X5: Widget cache-miss rebuild treats an empty filter list as success

description: pruneFilters(keeping:) then deletes every snapshot the app wrote. Failure scenario: combined with X1, one macOS widget refresh (which reads the wrong, empty store) blanks ALL desktop widgets. On iOS this manifests as a stale-read race that prunes freshly-written snapshots. Severity: Critical. Wave/Plan: Wave 5, plan 5b widget-snapshot-correctness. Sweep: cross-process.
